# EuroBioC2025 Carpentry Workshop: Single-cell RNA-seq

## Description
Analysis and interpretation of single-cell RNA sequencing data with Bioconductor: This course shows how to use Bioconductor packages for essential single-cell analysis steps including quality control, cell type annotation, multi-sample analysis, working with large data, and integration with public data.

**Pre-requisites:** Familiarity with R and Bioconductor. Familiarity with bulk RNA-seq data analysis is beneficial, but not strictly required.

**Instructors:** Robert Ivánek, Mireia Ramos, Kevin Rue-Albrecht

[Conference Website Page](https://eurobioc2025.bioconductor.org/pages/carpentryworkshops.html)

## Dates and Venue
**Dates:** Monday and Tuesday, 15–16 September 2025  
**Venue:** School of Medicine and Life Sciences, Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF), Barcelona
